description: This file defines the 'Visit' entity class within the OpenMRS core API. It models a patient's visit, including details like patient info, visit type, location, start and stop dates, and associated encounters and attributes.

classes.name: Visit
classes.description: Represents a patient's visit to a healthcare facility, keeping track of visit details, associated encounters, and attributes.

methods.name: getVisitId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the visit.

methods.name: setVisitId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the visit.

methods.name: getPatient
methods.description: Retrieves the patient associated with the visit.

methods.name: setPatient
methods.description: Assigns a patient to the visit.

methods.name: getVisitType
methods.description: Returns the type of visit.

methods.name: setVisitType
methods.description: Sets the type of visit.

methods.name: getIndication
methods.description: Retrieves the concept indicating the reason for the visit.

methods.name: setIndication
methods.description: Assigns a concept indicating the reason for the visit.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Gets the location where the visit occurred.

methods.name: setLocation
methods.description: Sets the location for the visit.

methods.name: getStartDatetime
methods.description: Returns the start date and time of the visit.

methods.name: setStartDatetime
methods.description: Sets the start date and time of the visit.

methods.name: getStopDatetime
methods.description: Returns the end date and time of the visit.

methods.name: setStopDatetime
methods.description: Sets the end date and time of the visit.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier (ID) of the visit, as part of OpenmrsObject interface.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier (ID) of the visit.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the visit.

methods.name: getEncounters
methods.description: Retrieves all encounters associated with this visit.

methods.name: setEncounters
methods.description: Sets the encounters linked to this visit.

methods.name: getNonVoidedEncounters
methods.description: Returns a list of encounters that are not voided.

methods.name: addEncounter
methods.description: Adds an encounter to the visit, establishing the bi-directional link.
